text:
maya: Heads up — multiple pods pending in eu-west1 GPU nodepool, starting ~09:12 UTC. CA didn't add nodes.
alex: link to alerts: <https://grafana/reports/123|gpu-pending-euw>
maya: events show kube-scheduler: 0/24 nodes are available: 24 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
leo: also seeing CNI flaps on the new nodes, some pods stuck in ContainerCreating
maya: pasted kubelet event:
```
Warning  FailedScheduling  5m (x18 over 1h)  default-scheduler  0/24 nodes are available: 24 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
Warning  FailedScheduling  2m (x3 over 20m)   default-scheduler  0/6 nodes are available: 6 node(s) had taint {gpu: exclusive}, that the pod didn't tolerate
```
jin: are these fractional GPU requests? any pods asking for 0.25 GPUs? :thinking:
maya: yes a batch of inference pods set limits.requests nvidia.com/gpu: 0.25 (legacy from test). CA won't scale fractional slices if nodepool only supports whole GPU allocs.
alex: config: nodepools have accelerator.gpu-type: a100-40, instance type is whole-GPU only. we also have fractional scheduling enabled on some clusters but not this one.
sam: ops-bot triggered scale up but then nodes failed VPC init and were NotReady, CA retried then capped by quota
ops-bot: [automated] scale_up: attempted 4 -> 8 nodes in eu-west1-gpu-pool at 09:15 UTC, 2 failed provisioning, quota error: "Insufficient regional GPUs"
leo: network team, CNI logs show slow IPAM allocation, timing out at 20s, then kubelet kills init container
jin: could we change pod requests to whole GPUs or enable MIG slices on this pool? MIG would help pack many 0.25 requests
mleng: cost tradeoff — enabling MIG on A100-40 increases overhead and changes perf, but improves packing for small inference replicas
alex: immediate mitigation: cordon nodepool-nonmig and move fractional pods to a nodepool with smaller GPUs (v100/rtx?) or a MIG-enabled pool
maya: I've created a priority-class for infra-critical model-serving and scaled a different nodepool manually to relieve backlog :white_check_mark:
sam: follow-ups: 1) audit all deployments for fractional GPU requests 2) check autoscaler node-template for MIG flag 3) request quota increase for eu-west1 GPUs
jin: also add a scheduler predicate to prefer nodes with free MIG slices, or use topologySpread to avoid fragmentation
maya: thanks — I'll open a runbook PR with steps and tag infra-oncall. If we still see preemptions we revert deployments to whole-GPU for the short-term :memo:
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-431
alex: Thanks, all. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
